description.value: Nerve limiter. Reduce the value of frightened and sickened on you by 1 (min 0). Stops working at Hollowed Drift or worse.

cinderfall.incomplete: Reducing the value of an existing frightened/sickened condition by 1 has no rule-element hook -- confirmed absence: even a real official pf2e monster ability making the identical claim ('When Obrimar becomes frightened, he reduces the condition value by 1,' pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/hells-destiny-bestiary/obrimar.json) ships rules: []. The Hollowed-Drift shutoff condition is a Cinderfall-homebrew state with no schema representation either.
